notes: These are explicit development limits, not generic FDM accuracy claims or a vendor sleeve OD tolerance.
Print a fit coupon and inspect/finish critical dimensions. Actual part dimensions must satisfy the drawing/inspection table.
Servo endpoints are calibrated from actual keeper position and measured stop margin, not inferred solely from pulse width or the nominal crank equation.
Retained dead-center alignment does not prove power-off vibration locking. Nominal slot free play allows keeper float.

disposition: Conditionally dimensioned prototype. Calibrate actual keeper travel and inspect stop margin; unknown print/hardware tolerances are not an automatic pass.
required_measurements: Actual critical printed dimensions and key/guide fit coupon
Sleeve OD, slot width, and side/axial free play
Retained keeper engagement and visible dead-center alignment
Released keeper travel, >=0.5 mm clearance past the actual lug, and >=0.5 mm to the physical released stop
Total installed pad preload between 0.5 and 3 N
